label: Some unpreceded moved POTENCY_1 has one of three alternatives in the same respect: no mover in act…
paraphrase: Some unpreceded moved potency has one of three alternatives in the same respect: no mover in act moves it; it moves itself and is in act; or a distinct mover in act moves it without simple priority. The selected being and respect are shared across the alternatives. Coverage does not assert exclusivity; the self and distinct-mover alternatives can overlap.
